consequence.statement: The `--dial-timeout` flag is deprecated and currently a no-op in Cilium 1.17.0; it will be removed in Cilium 1.18.

original.statement: The hubble-relay flag `--dial-timeout` has been deprecated and is now a no-op; it will be removed in Cilium 1.18.

consequence.statement: A `--dial-timeout` value set on hubble-relay has no effect from 1.17.0 because the flag is now a no-op. The flag will be removed in Cilium 1.18.
consequence.remediation: Remove `--dial-timeout` from the hubble-relay arguments, and do not rely on it to set the dial timeout.

corrected.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the hubble-relay flag `--dial-timeout` is deprecated and is now a no-op, so any configured dial timeout is no longer honoured. The flag will be removed in Cilium 1.18.

decision.reason: [ev-bcdbfe5ecd01] says the hubble-relay `--dial-timeout` flag is "now a no-op" in 1.17, so any value an operator sets is already ignored in this release. That is not just a future removal. The 'deprecation' kind covers things that still work today and break later, so it does not fit. A configured value that stops being honoured is setting-ignored, and removal in 1.18 is the next step after that.
